title: Bangsamoro vote transmission now at 98 percent — PPCRV
summary: The transmission of votes of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) parliamentary election to the server of poll watchdog Parish Pastoral Council for Responsible Voting (PPCRV)…

blocks.text: The transmission of votes of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) parliamentary election to the server of poll watchdog Parish Pastoral Council for Responsible Voting (PPCRV) was at 98.43 percent as of Tuesday morning.
